subject: Leap second
hook: LEAP SECOND IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Leap seconds are officially being scrapped: metrologists voted to abandon the adjustments by 2027 and let civil time drift up to a full hour away from the Earth's actual rotation, because inserting single seconds wreaked havoc on digital networks.
angle_support: On 15 October 2026, the General Conference on Weights and Measures (CGPM) voted to discontinue the addition or subtraction of future leap seconds with effect from 20 May 2027, and to increase the limit on maximum permitted variance to one hour.

This practice was disruptive, particularly in modern digital systems that require continuous and precise timestamping. Since not all systems implemented leap-second adjustments uniformly, some computational, networking, and satellite-based systems encountered anomalies.
title: Why Scientists Are Officially Killing the Leap Second
description: Global timekeepers have officially resolved to abandon leap-second adjustments by 2027. Rather than risking software crashes and telecommunication glitches, standard civil time will be allowed to separate from the planet's rotation by up to sixty minutes.
narration: LEAP SECOND IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You probably assume our clocks must stay strictly locked to the planet's physical spin. But preserving that ancient alignment became a modern technological crisis. Injecting erratic extra seconds created severe bugs across data networks and satellites. Because digital infrastructure demands uninterrupted precision, international metrology officials voted to abolish leap seconds starting in 2027. Clocks will simply be permitted to diverge by up to an entire hour from Earth's astronomical cycle. Human civilization chose stable computer servers over the rising sun.
